upstream.description: An engaging 1-on-1 chat interface between you and your AI agent.

classification.analysis: ClawTime is a self-hosted Node.js web chat interface that connects directly over WebSocket to a locally running OpenClaw AI agent gateway, offering voice conversations (browser speech recognition plus edge-tts), an animated 3D voxel avatar reflecting agent state, passkey (WebAuthn) authentication, and end-to-end encryption. It stores all history and credentials locally (`~/.clawtime/`) rather than routing through cloud chat services, and is designed to be installed and customized by the AI agent itself via a bundled SKILL.md. It targets hobbyists running a personal OpenClaw agent who want a private, expressive chat UI instead of a generic cloud chatbot.

use_cases.title: Give a self-hosted AI agent a private voice-and-avatar chat UI
Talk to a local AI agent by voice from a mobile browser over a tunnel
Let an agent customize its own chat interface and avatar in real time
